description: This file defines types, classes, and functions for handling test reporting, including serialization/deserialization of test results, managing test suites and test cases, and processing test events in a testing framework. It also includes a class for receiving and dispatching test report events.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Class for receiving, processing, and dispatching test report events, managing test suites and test cases, and integrating with a reporter.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case with its results, metadata, and hierarchy.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a test execution, including status, duration, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: serializeRegexPatterns
methods.description: Converts regex patterns into a JSON serializable format.

methods.name: parseRegexPatterns
methods.description: Parses JSON patterns back into string or RegExp objects.

methods.name: computeTestCaseOutcome
methods.description: Determines the overall outcome of a test case based on its results.

methods.name: asFullResult
methods.description: Converts a JsonFullResult into a reporterTypes.FullResult.

methods.name: asFullConfig
methods.description: Merges a JsonConfig with the baseFullConfig to produce a full configuration object.
